A24: REVENUE: base year = Inputs base revenue. Each forecast year = prior year x (1 + that segment's growth).
A25:   Total revenue = sum of the three segments (rows 2-4) in every column.
A26: PnL: Revenue links to Revenue total (row 5) of the same year.
A27:   COGS = revenue x (1 - gross margin). Gross profit = revenue - COGS.
A28:   Opex = revenue x opex %. EBITDA = gross profit - opex.
A29:   D&A = revenue x D&A %. EBIT = EBITDA - D&A. Tax = EBIT x tax rate. NOPAT = EBIT - tax.
A30: CASHFLOW: NOPAT and D&A link to PnL of the same year. Capex = same-year revenue x capex %.
A31:   NWC = same-year revenue x NWC % (base year included). Increase in NWC = NWC this year - NWC prior year.
A32:   Unlevered FCF = NOPAT + D&A - capex - increase in NWC.
A33: DCF: end-of-year discounting. Discount factor = 1 / (1 + WACC) ^ period.
A34:   PV of FCF = FCF x discount factor. Sum of PV = sum over years 1-5.
A35:   Terminal value = Year-5 FCF x (1 + g) / (WACC - g), valued at end of Year 5,
A36:   then discounted with the Year-5 discount factor. EV = sum of PV + PV of terminal value.
A37:   Equity value = EV - net debt. Per share = equity value / diluted shares.
